title: Eyk Timer
description: Type the minutes, press Enter, done. The window minimizes to the taskbar’s notification area and reopens when the alarm goes off.
features: Type 1–999 minutes and press Enter to start
Hover over the hourglass to see the time until the next alarm. Left-click to open the timer.
Up to ten timers, each cancellable
Press Enter to stop the alarm and hide the window
Light or dark, follows your system setting
The timer will be maintained to keep it reliable without adding unnecessary features.
releaseNotes: Version 1.0.2 updates the documentation and Store listing.
systemRequirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, x64, Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Tested on Windows 11 x64.
